name: CKM
summary: CKM, the muscle form of creatine kinase, an enzyme that regenerates ATP in muscle during very short, very hard effort. One variant in the gene was proposed in a 2010 Thoroughbred study as commoner among elite racehorses; the result did not hold up in that study's own second sample, and a later Quarter Horse study found no link with racing performance. No effect of either allele on speed, or on anything else, is established. T here is the allele that was proposed as favourable (A in the papers) and C the other (G in the papers).
